lines.en:
Let us raise a glass, to my friend, Protagonist!
Bet you all thought, he/she wouldn't make it this far, now ready to lead his/her first squad into battle. But I knew better!
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: Not in the celebrating mood, Protagonist?
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: There's a lot on the line... the Empress's life is in our hands.
lines.zh: 毕竟事关重大……女皇还等着我们拯救。

lines.en: I'm not worried. I doubt these guys can keep up with you.
lines.zh: 我不担心这个。我只是担心这些人会跟不上你的步伐。
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: ...It helps having a one man army in our midst.
lines.zh: 我们之中有个一人成军的人物确实蛮有帮助的…

lines.en: I'm just a man. We've got the gods on our side.
lines.zh: 我再强也只是肉身凡胎。但神明站在我们这边。
lines.name: 泽洛斯

lines.en: I'm going to trust in my soldiers, not some idea. Don't tell me you believe in those fairy tales now?
lines.zh: 我相信我的手下，而不是一些虚的东西。别告诉我，你现在竟然相信起了这些童话故事？

lines.en:
Don't underestimate the power of ideas. Look at how this empire's starting to forget the ideas that built it.  With a proper leader, people would again feel a part of something. There would be no generals going rogue...
We've come a long way since the Academy, but now we face the real thing. Come, Protagonist, let's brush up a bit.
lines.name: 泽洛斯
